name: guardian_jobs-mcp
description: Guardian Jobs (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Guardian Jobs job-board RSS (Madgex, RSS 2.0, 20 postings per page). keywords is the board's own search-box parameter (the feed of any search is the search URL under /jobsrss/) and page selects further pages of 20 (checked 2026-09-25: keywords narrows the feed; page=2 returns the next 20, an exhausted page returns an empty channel). location, remote and limit are not sent (location filtering on these boards uses internal location ids). title is 'Employer: Job title' and description begins with the salary line, so company and salary are not split out. id is the posting link.
